kind: pre-registration (criteria frozen BEFORE any measurement run)
claim_boundary: Feasibility-audit task-DESIGN measurement only: scripted mu-agnostic commitment plans, a per-mu oracle and a belief-free threshold-seeker are rolled out on candidate family-2 geometries to measure construction VoI and the clean-sensing seeker-vs-oracle gap. No driver promotion, training, repair-success, gate-validity, paper, or self-ID capability claim.
pinned_geometry_direction: large-radius straight (circle R=3000 m approximation) + laterally offset single obstacle = asymmetric gap choice; expressible today via obstacle.lateral_offset_range (env.py:516,551); per-cell degenerate-config mechanism reused from ramp_policy_voi_regime.py

candidates_frozen.intent: minimal geometry change: asymmetric gaps with per-episode random side (coin keyed by rollout seed), side choice reactive at reveal, mu-commitment = entry speed only (B2K2 engine on the new geometry)

obstacle.note: effective offset also inherits reset radial noise N(0,0.3) keyed by the same seed (documented jitter, breaks exact mu<->geometry inversion)

candidates_frozen.intent: full asymmetric-gap-choice semantics: the open (wide) side flips with mu at threshold 0.70 (per-cell degenerate configs); knowing mu before reveal predicts the correct gap side AND the entry speed; low mu -> obstacle offset left (open gap RIGHT, early lateral commitment pays), high mu -> obstacle offset right (open gap LEFT, keep speed for the deadline)
tightened variant of F2C2 in case its VoI lands below the bar: narrower corridor, wider obstacle, closed side fully blocked, tighter reveal and deadline

rejected_by_design_alternatives: warmup-gate-pinned approach line (gate disc forcing an off-center line so the near gap is the narrow one): rejected because warmup_gate collision has no env-native failure semantics (metric only) -> success criterion would need script-level composition, contaminating comparability with the B2K2 measurement semantics; and the pinned-line narrow-thread vs wide-swing trade-off collapses to the speed axis anyway (lateral detour path-length cost is negligible)

geometric impossibility note (reported as a design constraint): from a free centerline approach with a single offset disc, the wider gap is ALWAYS the nearer one (less displacement), so 'near-narrow vs far-wide' cannot be realized without pinning the approach line; the mu-signed open-side flip (F2C2/F2C3) is the honest single-obstacle realization of a mu-dependent gap choice

shared_task_constants.obs_contract: obs72 (history 1, action_history full, wheel none, no privileged)

seed_discipline.note: fresh stream; prior bases 20260611..20260622 all disjoint
seed_discipline.disjointness: selection and validation streams share no seed; candidate selection consumes only A/B; acceptance tau/dv selection only C; acceptance readout only D
seed_discipline.jitter_keys: distance jitter rng [SEED_BASE,777,seed]; F2C1 side coin rng [SEED_BASE,555,seed]

construction_criterion_frozen.name: commitment VoI (per-mu oracle vs best fixed plan), validation-stream
construction_criterion_frozen.definition: VoI_val = mean_over_12_points[ success_val(per-point best plan selected on stream A) ] - max_plan mean_over_points[ success_val(plan selected on stream A by mean) ], success_val measured on stream B (8 seeds/point -> 96 episodes per readout arm)
construction_criterion_frozen.plan_family: 28 mu-agnostic plans: entry speeds {4.5..11.5 step 1} x side policy {react, bias_left(+1.0 m), bias_right(-1.0 m)} with brake-then-swerve reaction, + 4 swerve-only react plans at {6.5, 8.5, 10.5, 12.0}
construction_criterion_frozen.separation_note: this criterion is computed from fixed commitment plans only; it shares no controller with the tested readout (threshold-seeker vs parametric oracle), breaking the construction/readout circularity

winner_selection_rule_frozen: winner = argmax VoI_val among candidates with VoI_val >= 0.25; tie -> lowest candidate index; if none qualifies -> report binding constraints per candidate (oracle ceiling vs reactive-dominance diagnosis), skip acceptance stage, deliver env-expressiveness gap list

acceptance_criteria_frozen.readout: clean-sensing two-regime acceptance on the winner: threshold-seeker (shortfall detector, tau/rate/backoff/dv re-selected for this family on stream C) vs per-mu parametric oracle (dv fine-tuned per point on stream C)
acceptance_criteria_frozen.validation_set: stream D: 12 mu points x 10 seeds = 120 episodes per arm (>= 120 required)
acceptance_criteria_frozen.oracle_strength_guard: parametric oracle success_val >= plan-family per-point oracle success_val (re-measured on stream D) - 0.02; if violated the gap readout is declared non-informative (oracle too weak) and reported as such
acceptance_criteria_frozen.report_also: Wilson 95% CIs for oracle and seeker rates; collision/timeout split; seeker telemetry (mu_hat error, censoring fraction, id_step, side prediction accuracy)

outcome_routes_frozen.all_candidates_fail_construction: report binding constraints + env expressiveness gaps; that is the Track-F result
outcome_routes_frozen.winner_fails_acceptance: report the gap with CIs; one bounded repair round allowed ONLY on controller calibration (speed-law constants/dv grids), never on the frozen geometry knobs or criteria; re-run acceptance on stream D once; if still failing, report as a clean-regime anomaly on family #2 (itself a result against the law's generality)
outcome_routes_frozen.degradation_scan: explicitly OUT of this track's scope (next stage, after Track W modes land); the final spec JSON must be directly consumable by that scan

compute_budget: single background process, ~15-25 min CPU expected (~15k episodes at ~0.04-0.1 s/episode); polled to completion
